verdict.rationale: Customer.io's App API is documented for fetching data, its CLI returns structured JSON from the Journeys UI API, and its AI/MCP tooling can report on how messages perform. That suggests performance data is reachable programmatically, but no source explicitly documents campaign or flow metrics endpoints for export to a warehouse or dashboard. The warehouse integration describes reverse ETL into Customer.io, not metrics out. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of campaign/flow/message metrics endpoints, a documented metrics export path to warehouses or BI tools, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards

citations.quote: To send broadcasts, transactional messages, and fetch data (outside of a _data out_ integration), use the App API.
It covers the Journeys UI API and CDP Data Pipelines API through a single `cio api` command
report on how your messages perform
